name: Swaathi Kakarla
title: Founder & CTO
bio:
Swaathi Kakarla is a tech founder, expert software architect, and Board Member & Fellow at Skcript. A prolific programmer who began coding at the age of 15, Swaathi co-founded Skcript and spent a decade serving as its Chief Technology Officer (CTO), fundamentally shaping the studio's engineering excellence and technical foundation.
As a Fellow at Skcript, she helps drive the strategic evolution of the company's complex technology infrastructure, focusing heavily on applied AI systems, advanced developer tools, and open-source contributions. Beyond her work at Skcript, she has lent her technical leadership as a co-founder and CTO to platforms like UnderstandBetter. Swaathi is highly regarded for her deep domain expertise in scalable backend architectures, machine learning workflows, and language constructs.

name: Karthik Kamalakannan
title: Founder & CEO
bio:
Karthik Kamalakannan is the Founder and CEO of Skcript, a premier global product and software development studio headquartered in Chennai, India. A designer at heart and an engineer by trade, Karthik has spent over a decade leading Skcript to become a benchmark for high-performance enterprise software and human-centric design.
Under his leadership, Skcript has successfully launched globally recognized products, including FeatureOS (formerly Hellonext), a leading customer feedback and product roadmap platform used by fast-growing teams worldwide. Known for his philosophy of "design-led engineering," Karthik bridges the gap between complex artificial intelligence infrastructure and seamless user experiences.
As a thought leader in the technology space, Karthik frequently writes and speaks about building bootstrapped businesses, scaling product design, and the real-world application of applied AI. He is deeply passionate about cultivating an exceptional engineering culture and mentoring the next generation of tech builders.

name: Saurabh Mishra
title: Lead Consultant
bio: Saurabh Mishra is a Cloud Evangelist and technology enthusiast specializing in cloud architecture, DevOps, automation, and Agentic AI. Through active community engagement, he shares practical knowledge on cloud-native solutions, AI-powered workflows, security best practices, and multi-cloud ecosystems.

name: Srushti Raybhoge
title: Software Engineer 2 (Google Developer Expert, Firebase)
bio: Srushti is a Google Developer Expert in Firebase and a full-stack engineer who thrives on turning emerging tech trends into scalable reality. As a frequent global speaker, she loves sharing her insights on the world stage and simplifying complex problems into elegant solutions. When she is offline, Srushti is usually traveling to new corners of the world, catching up on anime, or getting lost in a good book. She is always chasing the next big shift in technology and loves sharing those discoveries with her audience.

name: Bhargav Patel
title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
bio: Bhargav Patel is an AI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google, focused on agentic AI systems and LLM orchestration, and on the discipline of taking these systems from a working prototype to something a business can depend on in production. He has 3 peer-reviewed publications in applied machine learning and has spoken at more than 100 ML, MLOps, and AI events across India. Outside of work, he writes about AI engineering and MLOps on LinkedIn and Medium, and spends his time exploring food and anime.

name: Dinoy Raj
title: Product Engineer, Android
bio:
Dinoy Raj is a Product Engineer and Android specialist with a deep focus on building scalable, high-performance mobile experiences using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
He has shared his expertise on On-Device AI, custom launchers, and modern Android architecture at Droidcon Abu Dhabi '25, Droidcon Uganda '25, DevFest Dubai '25 and DevFest Mumbai '25. Dinoy will also be speaking at FOSSASIA 2026.

name: Jeeththenthar L
title: AI Engineer
bio:
Jeeththenthar is an AI Engineer at KovanLabs with 3 years of industry experience, and an active product builder working on multiple SaaS products such as AnalyzeDB, LearnVisually and PromptPilot. Jeeththenthar is passionate about turning ideas into real-world products and exploring how AI can solve practical problems.
Beyond work, Jeeththenthar actively participates in the tech community around Coimbatore through communities and events like GDG, TiE Kovai and AI Weekends, and also mentors students.

name: Varun Poladiya
title: B2B Marketing Leader (12+ years, AdTech/EdTech/IT/AI)
bio: Varun Poladiya is a tech marketer with 12+ years of experience across AdTech, EdTech, IT, and AI. He began his career at Google, then drove publisher ad revenue at Media.net for clients like Reuters and MSN. As co-founder of EduTronics, he taught coding and robotics to 4,000+ students and educators globally. Later, at navan.ai, he led marketing for AI products while training 1,500+ developers in vision AI across India, Malaysia, and Singapore.

name: Aditya Shinde
title: Founder
bio:
Aditya Shinde is the Founder of Ketoy and an Android developer with over 5 years of experience specializing in Android and Kotlin Multiplatform.
Deeply involved in the Android community, Aditya has delivered 20+ speaker sessions and workshops across Android, FlutterFlow and Kotlin Multiplatform to over 3,000 attendees.
Aditya also runs the Android-focused YouTube channel @DeveloperChunk (1,000+ subscribers) and publishes technical deep dives on Medium under the same handle.

name: Achintya Jai
title: Researcher, Privacy Tech
bio: Achintya Jai is a researcher from IIT Madras in India, hacking at the intersection of cybersecurity and AI. He spoke about multi-agent frameworks at UC Berkeley's AI summit as an invited speaker after winning their hackathon, and about privacy and automated privacy-breaking systems at PyCon. He is currently working on AI security products, especially in the field of OSINT. In his free time, he likes to read books and work on his solar race car as an electrical engineer.

name: Rashmi Asokan
title: AI Native Product Strategist
bio: Rashmi is an AI Native Product Strategist. She sits at the intersection of LLMs, business, and users. When she is not shipping, she is mostly yapping about tech on Instagram.

name: Aakash Dhakshnamoorthy
title: AI/ML Engineer & Strategist
bio: Aakash Dhakshnamoorthy is an AI/ML Engineer & Strategist at Zenardy Technologies, and an Oracle Certified GenAI Professional & Data Scientist. A Smart India Hackathon winner and mentor, Aakash has spoken at Global AI Bootcamp, Dev Summit, and Microsoft and Google AI sessions, conducts AI/ML, Cloud & Agentic AI workshops, and mentors hackathons. An open-source enthusiast, Aakash is a core member of Elasticsearch Chennai, contributes to FOSS United and volunteers at GDG Chennai.

name: Imran Roshan
title: Google Developer Expert, Google Cloud Security and Operations
bio: Imran Roshan is a Google Developer Expert in Google Cloud Security and Operations, on a mission to make information security fun. Imran is trying to enable AI-assisted security and helping make security easier for teams to adopt.

name: Gokulbarath N
title: AI & Robotics Engineer, Founder
bio: Gokulbarath N is an AI & Robotics Engineer and final-year Mechatronics student at Sathyabama Institute of Science & Technology, working at the intersection of AI and robotics, spanning LLM agents, computer vision, and full-stack ROS2 systems. Gokulbarath is also the founder of BGO Apps, a mobile studio building apps paired with AI systems.

name: Shangeeth Sivan Adiyapatham
title: Android Engineer
bio:
Shangeeth Sivan Adiyapatham is an Android developer, tech enthusiast and public speaker focused on building seamless experiences. With 9+ years of hands-on experience in Android application development, Shangeeth is passionate about crafting intuitive, high-performance mobile apps that solve real-world problems.
Shangeeth is constantly exploring the evolving tech landscape, from Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter to web development (Node.js/Express), iOS, MongoDB, and even game dev, VR and IoT.

name: Dishant Parakh
title: Program Associate, India Team
bio:
Dishant Parakh is a climate and energy policy professional working at the intersection of technology, data and public policy.
An analyst trained at the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) and the Urban Fellows Programme at IIHS, Dishant has worked across the Water-Energy-Food-Ecosystem (WEFE) nexus and pollution mitigation strategies. He has collaborated with organisations such as A-PAG, ATREE, Auroville Consulting, Quality Council of India, and The Peninsula Foundation. Alongside his practitioner work, he has contributed to multiple peer-reviewed, Scopus-indexed research publications and has presented his work at academic and professional forums.
Across these different areas, a common question runs throughout his work: how do we turn data and tech into decisions that actually work in the real world?

name: Dr Moumita Mukherjee
title: AI Team Lead
bio: Dr Moumita Mukherjee is the AI Team Lead at Solinas Integrity, a startup developing robotic and AI solutions for pipeline diagnostics and septic tank cleaning to help reduce water losses and eliminate manual scavenging. At Solinas, Dr Mukherjee has led the development of several AI-based models for automatic pipeline condition assessment. Before this role, Dr Mukherjee completed a Ph.D. in Computer Vision, working extensively on various computer vision algorithms, and has over four years of professional experience since.

name: Dr Nimeshika Jayachandran
title: Speaker
bio: Dr. Nimeshika Jayachandran is a physician and health & science journalist turned medtech strategist. She began her reporting career at The Times of India in Bengaluru and went on to head the health desk at The News Minute, where she was part of the team covering the 2018 Nipah virus outbreak and reported extensively on the COVID-19 pandemic. Today she leads strategic partnerships at MediSim VR, building the ecosystem for AI and VR simulation in healthcare training and competency assessment.

name: Pulkit Verma
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Pulkit Verma is an Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Madras, where he is a Principal Investigator at the Centre for Responsible AI (CeRAI). He is also an affiliate of the Center for Human-Compatible AI at UC Berkeley. Previously, he was a Postdoctoral Associate in the Interactive Robotics Group at MIT CSAIL. He received his Ph.D. from Arizona State University and his M.Tech. from IIT Guwahati. His research spans AI safety, lifelong learning with humans in the loop, and human-robot collaboration, with the goal of building AI agents that remain reliable and adaptable as they work with people. His work has been recognized with the ICAPS 2025 Outstanding Dissertation Award, the 2025 AAAI/ACM SIGAI Innovative AI Education Award, and the AAMAS 2022 Best Demo Award.

name: Gokulakrishnan L
title: Student
bio: Gokulakrishnan L is a 2nd-year undergraduate student at IIITDM Kancheepuram exploring cybersecurity, local systems, and privacy-first software development. An active participant in hackathons and tech workshops, he co-built "Gemma Monsters", securing 1st place at the GDG Windsor "Build with AI" Hackathon, and has competed in events like the ISRO and Build with AI hackathons. His practical projects include developing Flutter-based AI apps and exploring local, zero-telemetry LLM architectures.

name: Hariprasad Sudharshan
title: Product Manager, AI & API
bio: 16 years at Fujitsu, multiple U.S. patents and research papers, Global MIT Hackathon winner, and LlamaIndex contributor.

name: Sanju Sivalingam
title: Founding Engineer
bio: Sanju is the founder of THISUX, leading a team of developers and designers who build software users want to use. The team specialises in user-centric UX/UI design, modern web and mobile engineering, launching profitable MVPs and AI apps, working directly with startups and SMBs to design, develop and scale software within budget.

name: Kartikey Rawat
title: Senior AI/ML Engineer and Developer Advocate
bio:
Kartikey Rawat is passionate about Machine Learning, Edge AI and open-source innovation, and has contributed to TensorFlow through the TF.js project, enabling ML in the browser and beyond. A Google Developer Expert (GDE) in ML specialising in Computer Vision, Kartikey enjoys exploring cutting-edge frameworks like Keras, Gemma and on-device AI solutions.
Kartikey thrives on building impactful developer experiences, sharing knowledge through community initiatives, and pushing the boundaries of AI on mobile and embedded platforms.

name: Salman Faris
title: Community
bio:
Experience in hardware product development and prototyping across various development platforms.
Currently working with Screenly, focusing on digital signage solutions, Raspberry Pi-based deployments, and Edge App development. Involved in technical support, troubleshooting, and enabling secure digital signage infrastructures.
Active in maker communities and a passionate technology enthusiast, always interested in exploring and experimenting with new technologies.

name: Manu Vishwakarma
title: Lead Data Scientist
bio:
Applied data scientist with ~9 years of experience building and scaling Machine / Deep learning models that power personalization, ranking, trust & safety, and user engagement across large-scale consumer platforms.
Expertise spans recommendation systems, retrieval and ranking, Learning to rank (LTR), Large Language Models (LLMs), Computer vision, Natural Language Processing, Deep Learning and Machine Learning.

name: Shreya Sevelar
title: AI/ML Engineer I
bio: Entering the software engineering world with an inquisitive mind and a thirst for knowledge, Shreya is looking forward to exploring a career in AI and Machine Learning, and believes in harnessing the power of AI to drive change and build a sustainable future.

name: Somasundaram Mahesh
title: Founding AI Engineer
bio:
Somasundaram builds things that ship, with 10+ years in Android, most recently on apps that scale to 100M+ users, and years spent making video streaming fast, reliable and smooth at scale.
Lately the focus has shifted to AI. Somasundaram co-founded UnitedBy.AI, a Chennai community for engineers, designers and product minds who believe the best way to learn AI is to build with it: 120+ builders, in-person meetups, hackathons and demo days. No networking fluff, just people who make things.
On the technical side, Somasundaram is deep into AI agents, Claude Code workflows, and what it looks like when LLMs actively operate on Android devices. The stack is Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and KMP, with curiosity firmly at the Android + AI intersection.
